description: United States High-Resolution Building Stock Dataset (USHB) - Indianapolis is a data set deposited in und.library by its authors Siavash Ghorbany, Ming Hu. The United States High-Resolution Building Stock (USHB) dataset is a building-level dataset integrating structural attributes, envelope materials, archetype classifications, embodied carbon indicators, material quantity take-offs, and operational energy baselines for U.S. buildings. Coverage: national (US); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 956905027 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
